notes.title: Updates from the yard - Build Drop - 0.1.1.250808
notes.notes: [p]Hello fellow rail enthusiasts! 🤩 We have a lot of ground to cover with this huge update which encapsulates almost two months of work since our last Steam build release. So let’s get to it![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🆕 What's New?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]New Trains! We have 5 different trains for you to try out in the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/1b4df469d80507df8e73b4c53e5a9b868005bc1f.png"][/img][/p][p]We now have a  total of 286 props in the game which includes 75 Buildings, 88 decorative items & objects, 68 plants & trees, 37 rocks & terrain objects and 18 vehicles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/beab63c182355747f932f1410e9a9a49d0c41a16.png"][/img][/p][p]Tracks can now be edited using connected nodes. This is a feature we are continuously updating, so expect more soon! In the track mode, when you have a track selected you will see nodes you can select and move with your mouse. Holding down control will let you raise them above the surroundings.[/p][previewyoutube="kl_6alLdSzU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Better bridges! Yes, along with track editing, we had a chance to work on a system that creates procedural bridges that you will be able to customise more (in the future 😅). The current system automatically creates support structures when you edit your tracks and move those nodes vertically![/p][previewyoutube="gkqru2tZmCE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]New Dioramas and Map Picker! Keeping modding in mind, we've crafted our internal systems to now load custom maps and content. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/b53e64225936aac0fa5f17d36ce8b64eaa1ecaf4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The current system lets our artists create custom maps and dioramas that act as a starting point for your adventures![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/fb213c6b69a8d95d3124326ecc19657512efdfb0.png"][/img][/p][p]The same systems now facilitate loading and saving as well; which means you can now have multiple maps saved in the sandbox and experiment without worrying about losing progress or overwriting older content.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/028b406b13f524c27e2bb15d577713e939b93aba.png"][/img][/p][p]We also did a lot of quality of life fixes for the game. You have a whole slew of short keys and helpful features that should get you doing worldbuilding with props a whole lot faster. You can use the R, T and Y keys respectively to do simple rotate, move and scale operations on your props from where you have placed them. Holding down shift with the same shows you control handles that let you do more! You can quickly find all the short keys available to you in the pause menu under the section title controls.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/54222fa53e4e43e4a4fbee7b56a17566cd73bc65.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/df80b5e2fe7cb207c57e868cf91f548742e459d0.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Revisiting our track system gave us an opportunity to work on our flex track drawing algorithms as well as the preview system that shows you what you will be getting when extending tracks. The system tries its best to guess what sort of a curve you are trying to draw and helps you draw straight tracks, S curves and C curves with ease. If you want to cycle through curves while you draw, you can now use the Tab key to cycle through some dynamic curves as well, giving you a whole lot of control![/p][previewyoutube="dT8ojtIOnNI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You can hold down the Control modifier key on your keyboard and scroll the mousewheel to rotate a prop before placing them down; giving you finer control over where and how you position your props.[/p][previewyoutube="p787A3fGIiE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]😅 Yeah! That was a lot! So we hope that you get to try all the new features and please drop down to our discord (linked below) if you have ideas, found bugs or anything else! Have fun! 🌸 [/p][p][/p][h3][b]👀 Find us elsewhere![/b][/h3][list][*][p]If you know any railfans or city builder enthusiasts who would love this game, please ask them to sign up for a playtest here -[url="https://playmodeltrains.com"] https://playmodeltrains.com[/url][/p][/*][*][p]If you are not on our discord, please join us there for all our latest updates - [url="https://discord.secondquest.games"]https://discord.secondquest.games[/url][/p][/*][*][p]You can also catch our live streams on YouTube every month to get updates via our devlogs - [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@SecondQuest_/streams"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🙈 Also, follow our development journey through these channels:[/h3][list][*][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.secondquest.games"]https://discord.secondquest.games[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/secondquest_"]https://www.instagram.com/secondquest_[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Linked In: [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/second-quest/"]https://www.linkedin.com/company/second-quest/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Website: [url="https://secondquest.games/"]https://secondquest.games/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Playtest: [url="https://playmodeltrains.com"]https://playmodeltrains.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Updates from the yard - Build Drop - 0.0.14.250612
notes.notes: [p]🌟 We are back with another update! 😊[/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️⚠️⚠️ Since this build has a considerable amount of changes, you will need to clear existing game data by going to Settings > General > Default and clicking on the "Clear Game Data" button before playing the game. Not doing so may result in crashes or other un-intended behaviour. ⚠️⚠️⚠️[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/39905a020ca945e0f0116a97c2d1cbb970fa073a.png"][/img][/h3][h3]🆕 What's New?[/h3][p]Ok, so now that's out of the way, we have about two sprints worth of updates to show you. [/p][p]On the player facing side of things, we've been working on our modding tools into a unified framework for all content in the game, be it it created by us or content modders in the future. As a result of this, a lot of our pipelines got optimised and the load times for the game has drastically improved.[/p][p]The second major update is the context aware help! Depending on what tool is active, you can quickly access context sensitive help by pressing the ❓ icon on the top left of the screen. When you play the game for the first time, this system will automatically kick in and show you context aware help as you start using tools that you have not used before.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/796eacadae1d0ce236eb4cc7fb21d402a002fc60.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also been hard at work in creating new assets and content for the game. This process kicked off with cleaning up our existing assets library and making it a lot more cohesive. This is an ongoing process and you can expect more prop in future updates soon. We have also added new locomotives in the game which you can select from the track context menu in this build![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/169c02dcacf0106a52f277c594e45a921a5aac0e.png"][/img][/p][p][i]You can find a small list of all our larger updates from the last two sprints below.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Props and Trains now get loaded from Streaming assets, on demand[/p][/*][*][p]Prop system uses new and improved data structure[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game load times[/p][/*][*][p]Context Help added[/p][/*][*][p]Open screenshots folder added in photo mode[/p][/*][*][p]Train related bug fixes [/p][/*][*][p]More Trains added in Game[/p][/*][*][p]Prop content library clean up[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Key bindings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]👀 Find us elsewhere![/h3][list][*][p]If you know any railfans or city builder enthusiasts who would love this game, please ask them to sign up for a playtest here - [url="https://playmodeltrains.com"]https://playmodeltrains.com[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]If you are not on our discord, please join us there for all our latest updates - [url="https://discord.secondquest.games"]https://discord.secondquest.games[/url][/p][/*][*][p]You can also catch our live streams on YouTube every month to get updates via our devlogs - [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@SecondQuest_"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and interest. It really means a lot to us 💖[/p]

notes.title: Updates from the yard - Build Drop - 0.0.13.250508
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for checking out the update ✨[/b]

As we spoke about in our last dev log, this update is an intermediary step towards getting our base mechanics and systems in place for track laying and train movement. In parallel with this implementation, we also invested time in structuring our content modding pipeline to make the creation of locomotives, coaches, and trains much easier, both for our internal team and for future modders.

Note: This is currently only live for the Windows platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587784/fc6aa325bc0f1438acf38b1f7fdb67a5f0c526a6.jpg[/img]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated assets for tracks and scaffolding. Introduced Standard Gauge (1.43m) as default.
[*] Ability to select trains from the Track Context UI.
[*] Players can pick from two default trains now.
[*] Data manager for all train related assets in game (internal).
[*] Mod Manager - Helps in loading train related Mods (internal for now).
[*] Scene Lighting changes - trying some new lighting settings.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KG6bPr-TqBQ

There aren't a lot of content changes in the game with this patch. But we may have unfortunately introduced some bugs due to the shifts in the underlying structures of the game 🙈

[h3]Known bugs and issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clicking on Train doesn't enable Camera follow - only way to do camera follow is select track and click on enable/disable train
[*] Avoid using hotkey "T" to enable all trains at once. Might result in some unexpected behaviour
[*] Spawning trains on short tracks can cause Train to work weirdly
[/list]
